abstract: Aiming at the situation of lacking automation and informatization for the tunnel construction ventilation, this article proposed a monitoring system based on the fieldbus technology. The monitoring system consisted of three parts including the monitor cabinet, the local control cabinet and the fieldbus sensors. A monitoring program, which was written by the WinCC software, ran on the monitor cabinet. All the environmental parameters and working parameters could be displayed in the monitoring program. Meanwhile, a Programmable Logical Computer (PLC) was used as the master station of the Modbus network, which collected all the parameters from all the slave station sensors. In the local control cabinet, a PLC was used to receive all the parameters from the master station, and display them on the local screen. The transducer which drove the ventilator was also a slave station receiving the control signal from the master station to change the airflow. This system was tested at the construction ventilation project department in Tianmu mountainous tunnel. The result showed that this system improved the automation and informatization level of the tunnel construction ventilation monitoring system and reduced the cost of tunnel construction ventilation.

articleTitle: Motion Multi-object Detection Method under Complex Environment
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: An optimization object detection method based on color image symmetrical frame-difference is proposed in order to solve the problem of motion multi-object detection difficult under complex environment. In this paper, firstly the color images distance is defined to calculate the frame-difference between two adjacent images. Then the before and after symmetrical image-distance of three adjacent images in difference frame interval step can be completed respectively. Secondly, an optimization binary method is designed to extract more object pixels. And the before and after object binary results of the adjacent images with the same middle (key frame) image are given respectively. At last, motion multi-object of the key frame image is achieved by the fusion result of logical AND between the before and after object binary results depending on three-frame-adjacent images with the same key frame. Actual color images from traffic surveillance system are used to test, the experimental result shows that the optimization object detection algorithm based on symmetrical frame difference in the proper step can extract motion multi-objects in different movement speed under complex environment and its accuracy and effectiveness of the proposed algorithm are verified.

articleTitle: Study on Method of Multi-feature Reduction Based on Rough Set in Passenger Counting
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: In view of the instability and inaccuracy of the existed automatic passenger counting method based on the video sequence, in order to improve the instantaneity and effectiveness of the statistic method, this paper presented a new way based on multi-feature. It used single camera vertical shooting way to get the video, and extracted the moving targets in foreground by Gaussian mixture background model. A series of representative features to the foreground were extracted, such as aspect ratio, rectangularity, circularity, corner points of Shi-Tomasi, Hu invariant moments Fourier descriptors and LBP descriptors, after training these characteristics respectively, retained the high precision features and combined them all, in order to counting the number of people, this paper trained these features based on the neural network. In the experimental process, it evaluated the proposed method with several criterions, Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm has a high statistical precision and good efficiency.

articleTitle: On the Strategy of Event-Driven Injection and Ignition Synchronous Control for SI Engine
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: This work concerns on the spark-ignition and fuel-injection control strategy for Haima 479Q-BA four-cylinder four-stoke electronically controlled gasoline engine. By analyzing the synchronization work process between crankshaft, camshaft position signals and the sequence control of ignition and injection, a method is creatively proposed to realize position identification of missing teeth, and an event-driven based control strategy for injection pulse, ignition advance angle, injection and ignition timing control is also put forward. To insure the integrality of engine work sequence, a relative error correction mechanism is introduced to re-execute the failed event. The bench test results approve that the engine work process is stable and reliable under the developed control strategy, both the injection and ignition control signals are correctively performed, the timing control strategy is highly precise and effective.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Weighing Method for Portal Crane in Bulk Port: Based on Clustering and BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: In the process of cargo handling in bulk port, dynamic weighing of cargo is the basis of the information management system for bulk cargo handling. Due to many interference factors, it is difficult to obtain the actual lifting weight of portal crane by using mechanical way. To address this issue, a new method of using motor power is proposed in this paper. In this method, the real-time motor voltage, current and power factor during hoisting operations are collected and input into a pre-trained BP neural network to calculate the lifting weight of portal crane. K-means clustering algorithm is used to analyze and filter the measured data for finding the required power value. The BP neural network model can well reflect the relationship between lifting weight and the instantaneous output power of the portal crane hoisting mechanism motor (lifting motor and open-closed motor). Finally, the experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Game and Strategy of China in the World's Negotiation of Iron Ore Price
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: Chinese needs of iron ore have been increased sharply since 21st century and China is the biggest importing country of iron ore in the global. The uncertainty of the iron and steel industry has greatly increased with fluctuations in the iron ore global market, which has been a critical topic for the Chinese iron and steel industry. The price is also relating to the sustainable development of the iron and steel industry. In order to explore the Chinese advantage of iron ore pricing in the world trade, in this paper, the negotiated price of international iron ore is regarded as a starting point, using game theory to analyze the demand of iron ore between Japan and China, besides the process and results of price game between China and the Cartel, and explain the genesis of the current price of the game, the listed suggestions aim to get more measures to solve these dilemmas and problems which China is suffering. We think, China must adapt to the supply-side reforms and develop long-term strategies of importing foreign ore to ensure long-term development of the iron ore market. In addition, these measures are also feasible, such as acquiring equity interest income in the foreign stock market, enlarging new business, building steel firms in the counties with rich ore resources and so on.

articleTitle: Implementation of Automotive Inverter Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: A design scheme of automotive inverter power supply based on PIC was introduced.12V DC of the battery, through boost converter and inverter, the 220V/50 Hz voltage was achieved. In the boost part, high-frequency transformer was used in the push-pull circuit, then the isolated high voltage was achieved, in the inverter, the SPWM technology was used, in order to ensure the output voltage within the setting range. The strategy that changing duty cycle based on output voltage was used. Additionally, the input voltage detection circuit, the output voltage detection circuit and the output current detection circuit were designed, and the hardware prototype was developed. The experimental results show that the inverter power supply operates steadily, and further verify the control strategies of the system are rational.

articleTitle: Intelligent Mutation Operator of Biogeography-Based Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: The mutation operator of Biogeography-Based Optimization (BBO) makes a large advance for the diversity of the solution space. Generally speaking, the quality of a solution is closely related with the maximum mutation rate, which is always decided by experience. But for the different situations, the maximum mutation rate may be different. In this paper, we propose an Intelligent Mutation Operator of Biogeography-Based Optimization (IMOBBO), which could find the suitable maximum mutation rate in overall benign ranges. Extensive simulation results are provided to demonstrate the effectiveness and the sharpness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Accelerating Spatial Join Aggregation with R-Tree for MapReduce
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: Spatial Join Aggregation (SJA) is a time-consuming operation in the spatial database, how to design efficient distributed SJA algorithms is attracting more and more attention. The paper proposed a strategy (RSJA-MR) to process spatial join aggregation in MapReduce based on distributed R-tree, which is used to return results of SJA more efficiently. SJA tasks met independent parallel computation and could easily be expressed in MapReduce. The experiment results show that, RSJA-MR is out perform the non-indexed SJA stratedgy in the time performance.

articleTitle: A Communication Model for Large Scale Ship Handling Simulators
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: In this paper, we proposed a novel communica-tion solution for ship handling simulators by using both multiaddress broadcast and connection oriented socket, which has advantages such as few data flow, less of data blocking, easy to extent and deploy, access an exercise at runtime, etc.

articleTitle: Exploring Chinese Language Evolution via Computer Corpus Analysis: A Case Study of Liru's Lexicalization and Grammaticalization
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: No consensus has been achieved about part of speech of liru (for example in English equivalent, in Chinese characters) among Chinese linguists, and moreover the diachronic perspective of big data-though most promising-was seldom adopted owing to technological constraints. This study deploys a diachronic corpus of Chinese language to examine the evolution of liru across the time span of ancient and modern Chinese. Results show that, contemporary liru undergoes lexicalization of li and ru from as early as the Six Dynasties (222-589 A. D.) and grammaticalization of liru through their semantic blurring. It is as a result of complexities and subjectivity in the communication contexts, liru gradually takes on discoursal functions of illustrating.

articleTitle: A Review of Soft Computing Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: A review of deep learning based soft computing techniques in several applications is presented. On one hand, soft computing, defined as a group of methodologies, is an important element for constructing a new generation of computational intelligent system and has gained great success in solving practical computing problems. On the other hand, deep learning has become one of the most promising techniques in artificial intelligence in the past decade. Since soft computing is an evolving collection of methodologies, by presenting the latest research results of soft computing based on deep learning, this review not only reveals a promising direction for soft computing by incorporating deep learning, but also gives some suggestions for improving the performance of deep learning with soft computing techniques.

articleTitle: Problems of PHM Technology Application in the Marine Gas Turbine Engine and Coping Approaches
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Informatics - Computing Technology, Intelligent Technology, Industrial Information Integration (ICIICII)
abstract: The application of prognostics and health management (PHM) technology in the marine gas turbine engine could improve engine reliability and availability and reduce life cycle costs effectively. This paper analyzed the problems of PHM applying to the marine gas turbine engine, such as the limits to fix sensors, the limits of monitoring means, the difficulties of weak fault diagnostics, the difficulties of extracting degeneration features and judging the fault point, and proposed several strategies to solve the problems, such as developing the high temperature wireless intelligent sensors, expanding the monitoring means and weak fault diagnostics techniques, researching combined prognostic methods, developing long-distance distributed systems and so on.
